answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 16617 Country: Pakistan Title: Bismillah Assalamoalaikum! Is this true "Hadith", that if a person having unlimited "Qaza Sala'h" then on Last Friday of this Month of Ramadan, pray 4 raka't Nafil, in each raka't after Sura-e-Fatiha, recite 7 times Ayatul Kursi and 15 times Sura-e-Kauser. This Nafil Sala'h will be the Qaza or Kaffara for atleast Sala'h of 700 years. WallahuAlam, but I did not heared this thing before, please clarify my doubts, Allah will bless you. Jazak Allah Khair Question: Bismillah Assalamoalaikum! Is this true "Hadith", that if a person having unlimited "Qaza Sala'h" then on Last Friday of this Month of Ramadan, pray 4 raka't Nafil, in each raka't after Sura-e-Fatiha, recite 7 times Ayatul Kursi and 15 times Sura-e-Kauser. This Nafil Sala'h will be the Qaza or Kaffara for atleast Sala'h of 700 years. WallahuAlam, but I did not heared this thing before, please clarify my doubts, Allah will bless you. Jazak Allah Khair Answer ID: 16617 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1604/1276/L=1430) There is no such salah, neither this will suffice for the missed prayers, rather a person should have to perform qadha of all missed salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
